title: Pay-in-Full Offer on Advance Payment of Pre-K Tuition
content:
**Offer.** Under the pay-in-full offer of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the discount on an advance payment of Pre-K tuition is set by the number of months paid in advance, that is, the months of the school year not yet posted:

| Months paid in advance | Discount |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | half of one month at the most recent billing month's tuition charge, in place of the standard discount |
| 3 or 4 | the standard discount: 3 percent of those months at the most recent billing month's tuition charge |
| fewer than 3 | no discount |

## Worked discounts (hypothetical most recent tuition charge of 300.00)

| Months paid in advance | Discount |
|---|---|
| 6 | half of 300.00, that is 150.00 |
| 5 | 150.00 |
| 4 | 3 percent of 1,200.00, that is 36.00 |
| 3 | 3 percent of 900.00, that is 27.00 |
| 2 | none |
